item.title: Problems Using Go mod
item.description: 1. go.sum Version Mismatch After Upgrading Go Running the command go build reports an error. Error message: missing go.sum entry for module providing package golang.org/x/time/rate; to add Solution: Update go.sum before go build by running the command go mod tidy. 2. TLS Error Running the command go mod download reports an error.
